updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector – Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The RMS connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, requiring admins to configure their own Entra app registration and certificate via new PowerShell cmdlets. This security improvement removes the need for automatic service principal provisioning and gives administrators direct control over authentication credentials.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Extended Backup & Recovery (30-Day)
updates.summary: Entra ID now supports extended 30-day point-in-time backup and recovery for tenant objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or APIs, allowing admins to restore to any historical state within the rolling 30-day window. This complements the existing 7-day recovery included with P1/P2 licenses and significantly improves disaster recovery and compliance capabilities.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services: Enhanced sAMAccountName Synchronization
updates.summary: Entra Domain Services now supports synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute, with the feature enabled by default for new managed domains and available as opt-in for existing ones. This improves compatibility with on-premises applications and legacy directory-dependent systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online Classification Failures
updates.summary: Administrators can now create granular DLP policies that respond to specific classification or text extraction failure types (such as timeouts and throttling) rather than applying one blanket policy for all failures. This public preview feature gives IT teams finer-grained control over how Exchange Online handles scanning errors.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be consolidated by user even when multiple rules match, reducing alert noise and simplifying investigation workflows by grouping related violations into single alert objects. This launched feature improves SIEM integration and incident response efficiency for security teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard displays MTTA/MTTD/MTTR metrics and trends for DLP alerts, with customizable SLA thresholds for high, medium, and low severity incidents. Security and compliance teams can now track operational performance against defined SLAs and identify which sensitive information types are most frequently exposed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Grouping Modernization
updates.summary: The sensitivity labeling scheme is being simplified to use only labels and label groupings (replacing the previous parent-label model), making it easier for admins to organize and categorize their labels. This modernization improves label usability and reduces configuration complexity.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: Scanner labeling, classification, and protection actions are now stored in SQL tables, enabling admins to create custom reports on the state of scanned repositories. This capability allows organizations to build tailored compliance and data governance dashboards aligned with their specific reporting requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Azure PST Import
updates.summary: PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage can now be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the Exchange Migration Service pattern with analysis and execution phases. This capability streamlines mailbox migrations for organizations managing large volumes of archived email data in cloud storage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Expanding Archive Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit for eligible E5 license holders, ensuring continuous retention and scalable archive growth without mailbox inoperability. This removes a significant capacity constraint for organizations managing large-scale compliance and retention requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (Box, Google Workspace)
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace by leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the standard Microsoft 365 classification engine. This extends DLP enforcement to multi-cloud environments and hybrid SaaS deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Before enforcing auto-labeling policies, admins can run them in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without making changes, review match results, and assess source distribution. This preview capability reduces the risk of unintended labeling at scale and helps teams validate policies before production deployment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: A new Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details displays at-a-glance performance metrics that vary based on simulation or enforcement mode, helping admins understand labeling identification and coverage rates. This visibility enables data-driven tuning of labeling strategies and compliance effectiveness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now protect sensitive data in non-Microsoft connected applications including Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and Microsoft 365 classification capabilities. This extends compliance automation to multi-cloud storage environments beyond Microsoft 365.
